page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.r7.8xlarge consistently in the average performance tier across most compute and memory metrics. The Intel Xeon processor delivers a single-core stress-ng score of 1865.39 and a multi-core score of 30983.52. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 1689.81 GB/sec, which drops to 141.73 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, alongside a write speed of 65.94 GB/sec. Notably, the instance exhibits strong performance in text generation for small 135M language models, achieving 282.15 tokens/sec, while medium 7B model text generation operates at an average rate of 17.54 tokens/sec.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.r7.8xlarge offers a high RAM allocation per core, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for memory-bound workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. The lack of local storage requires users to factor in network storage latency. This instance is configured for workloads such as in-memory databases, Redis caching layers, software compilation, and moderate-scale language model inference.
